_meta.description: Machine-readable index of every module in the NCE Studio Frappe app. Read this file FIRST before exploring the codebase — it tells you exactly where to look for any given concern.
_meta.usage: Find the module whose 'purpose' matches your task, then read only that file and its 'depends_on' entries.

architecture.overview: NCE Studio is a Frappe framework app with a Python backend (doctypes, whitelisted APIs) and a Vue 3 + Pinia frontend. The frontend never touches the database directly — all data flows through frappe.call() to 9 whitelisted endpoints.
architecture.data_flow: Vue Component → Pinia Store → dataPipeline.ts (frappe.call) → nce_api.py re-export hub → lock_api / field_api / theme_api → Frappe ORM → MariaDB
key_patterns: Backend uses is_system_manager() helper from utils.py — never inline role checks
Frontend uses safeEval.ts for condition evaluation — never new Function() or eval()
Edit locks use SELECT FOR UPDATE for atomicity
CSS values are validated server-side before injection
All whitelisted endpoints include permission checks
